rules: When the CY bit in the scounteren register is clear, attempts to read the cycle register while executing in U-mode will cause an illegal-instruction exception.
When the CY bit in the scounteren register is set, access to the cycle register is permitted while executing in U-mode, provided the corresponding bit in mcounteren is also set.
When the TM bit in the scounteren register is clear, attempts to read the time register while executing in U-mode will cause an illegal-instruction exception.
When the TM bit in the scounteren register is set, access to the time register is permitted while executing in U-mode, provided the corresponding bit in mcounteren is also set.
When the IR bit in the scounteren register is clear, attempts to read the instret register while executing in U-mode will cause an illegal-instruction exception.
When the IR bit in the scounteren register is set, access to the instret register is permitted while executing in U-mode, provided the corresponding bit in mcounteren is also set.
When the HPMn bit in the scounteren register is clear, attempts to read the hpmcountern register while executing in U-mode will cause an illegal-instruction exception.
When the HPMn bit in the scounteren register is set, access to the hpmcountern register is permitted while executing in U-mode, provided the corresponding bit in mcounteren is also set.
If a bit in the scounteren register is read-only zero, reads to the corresponding counter will cause an exception when executing in U-mode.
All bits in the scounteren register are WARL fields.
